programs.title: Hunt For The Wilderpeople
programs.desc: This comedy-drama, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. (Sam Neill).

programs.title: Pride & Prejudice
programs.desc: For the Bennet's, life is uneventful until the arrival of the rich gentleman Mr Bingley. Love is soon in the air for one of the Bennet sisters, while another may have jumped to a hasty prejudgment.

programs.title: Jane Eyre
programs.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, a former orphan works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester. To secure her own future and come to terms with the past that haunts her she must act decisively.

programs.title: The Ideal Palace
programs.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval, comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'.

programs.title: Delfin
programs.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin, an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small town outside of Buenos Aires. Delfin's ambition is to join a children's orchestra in a neighbouring village.

programs.title: The Crow's Egg
programs.desc: When Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop, two slum boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice with their own money.

programs.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programs.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programs.title: The Lost King
programs.desc: In 2012, having been lost for over 500 years, the remains of King Richard III were discovered beneath a carpark in Leicester by an amateur historian, who in her efforts, defies the stodgy academic establishment.

programs.title: Iris
programs.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. (Kate Winslet).

programs.title: The Daughter
programs.desc: Christian returns to his hometown for his father's wedding. Reconnecting with childhood friends and family, he unearths a long-buried secret that threatens to shatter lives.

programs.title: Hope Springs
programs.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her skeptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programs.title: Men
programs.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.
